task: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First, it would be a great idea if you could ensure that the chest drawer is open. After that, retrieve the old key from the chest drawer within the bedroom. If you can get your hands on the old key, unlock the wooden door with the old key. And then, open the wooden door in the bedroom. After that, make an attempt to venture east. Then, open the refrigerator. Then, take the tomato plant from the refrigerator within the kitchen. Then, place the tomato plant on the stove. That's it!
